# Upstream test fixtures

The `pi-fast` and `pi-codex-tools` source fixtures and
`../support/codex-harness.mjs` were copied from `jvm/pi-mono` commit
`d21db11b636ad285f95c8269baa52f849376e2cd`.

They exercise the original cooperating-extension contracts without depending
on a sibling repository. Upstream license and notice files are retained.
